pages.text: I can cross a short distance along my line of sight.

$(bold)Mana:$() ¼ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim forward and cast. The spell searches for a safe loaded destination with enough room for my body and teleports me there, preserving my orientation and clearing fall distance. It refuses unsafe or obstructed destinations.
pages.title: Method and Limits
